items.title: Real-Time Location Tracker
items.description: Live location tracking, route recording and saved paths on Google Maps.
items.longDescription: A Flutter app built with Google Maps and Geolocator that delivers real-time location tracking, dynamic route recording, interactive map animations and local storage for saved paths.
highlights: Route recording drawn live on Google Maps
Saved paths stored locally on the device

items.title: Flappy Bird Clone
items.description: 2D arcade game with collision detection, parallax backgrounds and a saved best score.
items.longDescription: A Flappy Bird–inspired 2D game built with Flutter and the Flame engine, using game components, collision detection and a parallax background.

items.title: Third-Person Shooter
items.description: Third-person movement, shooting and object interaction with DOTween-driven doors and chests.
items.longDescription: A 3D third-person shooter prototype made with Unity, focused on character movement, shooting and basic object interaction.
highlights: Third-person controller extended from Unity Starter Assets
Door, chest and moving-object animation with DOTween

items.title: Task Manager
items.description: Auth, profile editing, task CRUD, search and status tracking over a REST API.
items.longDescription: A task management app built with Flutter and Dart on top of a REST API.
highlights: Sign up, log in and profile updates
Status tracking: New, In Progress, Completed

items.title: 2D Action Platformer
items.description: Fast, responsive movement and combat in a Metroidvania-style platformer.
items.longDescription: A fast-paced 2D action platformer prototype made with Godot, focused on tight, responsive movement.

items.title: Contact Manager
items.description: Offline contact book with full CRUD, search, favourites and light/dark themes.
items.longDescription: A Flutter contact management app built on a local SQLite database.

items.title: RideSchedule
items.description: Ride scheduling back end built on Django’s MVC structure.
items.longDescription: A Python/Django back-end application developed with Django's MVC structure and an SQLite database.

items.title: Pac-Man
items.description: The arcade classic rebuilt from scratch with OpenGL.
items.longDescription: A Pac-Man game written in C++ with OpenGL.

items.title: Mini C-to-Assembly Compiler
items.description: Parses a C-like language with arithmetic and control flow and emits assembly.
items.longDescription: A mini compiler written in Python that parses a custom C-like syntax, supporting arithmetic and control structures, and emits assembly instructions.

items.title: Analog Clock
items.description: A real-time analog clock rendered with OpenGL primitives.
items.longDescription: An analog clock built with C++ and OpenGL.
